claims.statement: The chat wire is still CopilotKit: the drop-CopilotKit plan's M3/M4 are not started, package.json still depends on @copilotkit/react-core and runtime, and app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]]/route.ts still exists.

Server components call the backend over REST via apiGet in lib/api/client.ts, whose base is AGENT_URL with the trailing /agent stripped, falling back to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL then http://localhost:8010; it attaches the user's Supabase bearer token and throws NotFoundError on 404.

Chat does not call the backend from the browser: AgentProviders points CopilotKit at /api/copilotkit, whose CopilotRuntime registers two HttpAgents (sangam_agent at AGENT_URL, sangam_ingest at AGENT_URL with /agent replaced by /ingest) behind an InMemoryAgentRunner, with maxDuration 1800 to match the backend.

AGENT_URL must end in /agent (used verbatim for Ask, suffix swapped for Import, stripped for REST) while NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL has no suffix and is the browser-side REST base; docker compose sets AGENT_URL to the internal backend:8000/agent and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to localhost:8010.
Client components do REST with fetch to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL using authHeaders(), with a shared call() helper that throws ApiError carrying status and body.

proxy.ts runs Supabase updateSession on all non-static paths, refreshing the session via getClaims and redirecting signed-out visitors on /import (the only protected prefix) to /auth/login?next=; /ask stays public, and without Supabase env keys nothing is gated.

AgentProviders holds the Supabase access token (initial session plus onAuthStateChange) and sends it as an Authorization Bearer header on chat requests; the auth callback only honours same-origin next paths via safeNextPath.
apiGet caches signed-out reads with next revalidate 300 only in production and only when there is no Authorization header; signed-in and development requests use no-store.

/ask is force-dynamic and checks the session server-side: signed out it renders AskPreview (sample content, no agent call, question parked in sessionStorage across sign-in and prefilled but not sent), signed in it fetches an index payload via apiGet and renders the workspace; ?view=import redirects to /import.

The Ask workspace lazy-loads via next/dynamic so the CopilotKit runtime downloads only when rendered; AskWorkspace keeps its views (ask, chats, funder-match, proposals, rfpwatch, vault, media) as in-app state, and ChatPane is keyed by threadId so switching chats remounts it.

Ask thread lists come from GET /api/threads with localStorage (sangam_threads_v1) only as a title fallback and for a just-started chat; reopened chats load saved messages from /api/threads/{id}/messages, where a 404 means an empty chat.

useAgentChat is the shared chat hook for Ask (sangam_agent) and Scout (sangam_ingest): it wraps CopilotKit useAgent and folds messages into turns, turning tool calls into trace steps matched to tool results, excluding subagent-run prose from the answer, tracking subagent lane owners from live events only, loading history only after the agent is ready and empty, and running/stopping via copilotkit.runAgent/stopAgent.

Proposals are browser-only: stored in localStorage under sangam.proposals.v1 behind a useSyncExternalStore store with cross-tab storage sync, no backend table; started from a Funder Match card by snapshotting match detail into gates; only steps 1-2 are implemented and step 3 sections is a read-only placeholder.

The /import route is force-dynamic and validates ?thread= against an import-uuid pattern; ImportLoader lazy-loads ImportPage with ssr false; ImportShell owns the thread id mirrored into the URL and lists past runs; ImportView loads all panels with a single GET /api/ingest/overview and shows team tools only to staff.

Import pause cards (SourcesCard, SaveQuestions, ImportApproval) answer backend interrupts through CopilotKit useInterrupt with renderInChat false, rendered once into a single DOM node that ScoutChat portals into the visible layout; SaveQuestions resolves with the decision and slug so parallel paused writers can be addressed.

useRunPause records the tool a run stopped on from the interrupt custom event or a RunFinished with outcome interrupt, and ScoutChat disables its composer as stuck when the run is idle, no card is open and a pause is recorded.

Sources ticked before the first message are sent to the backend as AG-UI agent context with the exact description 'Sources the person ticked for this Import run', which the backend's TickedSources middleware looks up.

While an Import run is going, composer messages are not sent to the agent: askLive posts to /api/ingest/threads/{id}/ask-live and the backend answers from run state; text classified as an instruction is queued and sent as the next message after the run ends with no card open.

The Scout step shown in the UI (Start, Working, Review, Done) is derived on the client from isRunning, whether a review card is open and counts from DoneReport, with the working board built from the turn's tool steps and lane owners.

The drop-CopilotKit plan targets an out-of-memory failure in the relay (InMemoryAgentRunner buffering every event plus raw LangGraph event copies); its M3 would replace CopilotKit hooks with an @ag-ui/client HttpAgent talking directly to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL /agent and /ingest, delete the proxy route, and accept losing mid-run reload replay.

The design system lives in the Claude Design project 'Sangam Design System v2' as system of record; UI PRs must update it in the same PR, tokens share CSS variable names with globals.css, and rules fix corner radii, type scale, AA contrast, Lucide icons and a single page-max column.

Frontend code is organised as routes-only app/ (everything else goes in features/), one features/ folder per screen, components/ui and components/layout, and lib/; list pages share the BucketCards/FilterRow/SearchBox/ListMore pattern in components/ui/ListPage.tsx, with useShowMore for client-side paging and useCursorList for server cursor paging, and new list pages must reuse it.
